subject: HearthBank: automated quality-guardrail for production rollouts
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@hearthbank.com>
Cc: HearthBank Legal <legal@hearthbank.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: HearthBank: automated quality-guardrail for production rollouts

Team —

Quick context: HearthBank is signing next-week for a Private deployment + 12-month commitment. Legal attached an addendum that requires an automated quality gate for any model or parameter change that affects the customer’s protected prompt set. The ask from the customer is:

- Before a new model version or config rollout touches production for their tenant, run an automated evaluation against their supplied "critical prompts" and block the rollout if the chosen quality metric degrades by >2% (precision@K on their scoring label).
- Provide a human-approval path (customer + Redwood product owner) to override the block with an audit trail.
- Expose the evaluation results and raw per-prompt diffs to HearthBank via the Console and via webhook.
- Retain evaluation traces for 90 days to satisfy audit requests.

They flagged this as a contract requirement — no-go without it. Close date target is 2027-02-25. Legal expects an implementation approach (and an implementation fee if this is a deal-specific extension).

Attachments: HearthBank_SLA_Addendum_v3.pdf; hb_quality_prompts_v1.csv (sample prompt set).

Ask: can Product/Eng scope whether this is feasible within a 2-week bespoke delivery vs a longer productized feature? If the product route is longer, what minimal guardrail can we promise to get the contract over the line?

Thanks — I need a quick assessment for the execs and a costing proposal to share with HearthBank.

—Priya
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai

---

On Sun, 14 Feb 2027, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@hearthbank.com> wrote:
> Thanks Priya — as discussed, the bank’s regulators want an automatic stop for any regression on our critical prompts. We need a deterministic block; a human override is acceptable but must be logged and auditable.
> 
> —Sanjay

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@hearthbank.com>, HearthBank Legal <legal@hearthbank.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HearthBank: automated quality-guardrail for production rollouts

Thanks for the clear ask, Priya. I copied the questions we need to scope impact and options: 

1) Metrics: Are they locking to a single metric (precision@K) and a single threshold (2%) for all types of changes? Or do they accept different metrics for embeddings vs generation?
2) Enforcement point: Does the bank require the gate to run in their private control plane (on-prem/VPC) or is a control-plane-driven check (hosted eval job with results fed back) acceptable under the contract?
3) Approval flow: Do they require a two-party approval (customer + Redwood) or is a single party able to override?
4) Telemetry: 90 days retention noted — confirm expected log volumes and whether PII redaction is needed in the stored artifacts.

High-level options we can consider: 
- Option A (productized): Build a platform "Quality Gate" integrated into Rollouts + Optimize. Would include automated eval runs, pass/fail policy, Console UI for approvals, webhooks, and retention. Est. 3 sprints to fully productize.
- Option B (deal-specific MVP): A narrowly scoped service that runs the customer-provided prompt harness pre-rollout and enforces blocking via a custom rollout policy for that tenant only. Manual approval via ticket or a simple Console button. Est. 2 weeks of focused Eng work + backlog items for plumbing.

Next: Marcus, can you weigh in on the technical feasibility & compute cost for Option B vs A? Priya — can we get final confirmation from HearthBank on the three items above?

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Product Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@hearthbank.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 14:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HearthBank: automated quality-guardrail for production rollouts

Quick feasibility notes from Eng: 

- Option B (deal-specific MVP): doable. Implement a small evaluation runner that:
  * pulls the HB prompt set from the attached CSV,
  * runs the in-cloud eval harness against the candidate model (or config),
  * computes the precision@K diffs, and
  * if diff > threshold, sets the rollout policy to "blocked" for that tenant via an API call.

  We can wire a Console button to trigger a manual re-run and surface the JSON results. Webhooks are trivial to add. Retention for 90 days is feasible; will need S3 bucket + index. Estimated effort: 2 engineers full-time for 10 business days (approx 2 weeks), plus ops time to stand the S3 bucket and a small evaluation job queue. Incremental infra cost for the evaluation runs depends on frequency (typically 1000 prompts / run ~ small GPU or large CPU job).

- Option A (productized): much more scope: UI workflows, multi-metric support, RBAC for overrides, audit trail hooks, and integration with Rollouts. Ballpark 6-8 engineers across 3 sprints (6 weeks) before GA.

Risk/notes: If HearthBank wants the enforcement to run inside their VPC (private control plane), we need deployment packaging for the eval runner or an admin-guided runbook; that adds 1-2 weeks for secure deployment steps and qualification. Also, storing prompt contents may be a compliance no-no; if Legal requires redaction we should store only hashes and metrics.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@hearthbank.com>
Cc: HearthBank Legal <legal@hearthbank.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 17:09:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HearthBank: automated quality-guardrail for production rollouts

Thanks all — helpful breakdown. HearthBank confirms the ask: single metric (precision@K) with 2% threshold for generative responses on their critical prompt set, and they accept a single override by Redwood + audit logging. They prefer the enforcement to run in their Private deployment but are willing to accept a hosted evaluation if we can guarantee no prompt retention.

Given time pressure, Sales proposes the following trade: deliver Option B (deal-specific MVP) scoped to HearthBank inside their Private control plane. Delivery target: 2 weeks (end of day 2027-03-03). Charge: $50,000 implementation fee + cover incremental eval infra. We will include redaction-by-hash for prompt storage and wire a Console button + webhook for approval. 

Please confirm that Eng can commit to the two-week window and that Legal will accept the redaction approach. If Eng can confirm, I will send the PO + DocuSign (link below) and ask HearthBank to sign by 2027-02-24 to hit our timeline.
